content.intro: Learn database indexes through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.
content.why_it_matters: Database Indexes matters because a Django project has to behave predictably across requests, database state, configuration, and deployments. Understanding this piece makes the surrounding application easier to test, maintain, and secure.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines database indexes as part of database configuration, migrations, and transactions. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.

content_blocks.title: What to cover
content_blocks.text: The source syllabus for this lesson names: Single-column indexes; Composite indexes; Unique indexes; Indexes for common filters; Measuring index effectiveness. Keep these distinct concepts together: know what each item does, when it applies, and what assumption must be verified in your project.

items.title: Single-column indexes
items.text: Single-column indexes should be evaluated using a representative workload and a measured baseline. Compare correctness and resource usage before and after the change; the best choice depends on the database backend, request mix and data size.
